event: 2026 ILCA SENIOR EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 213024 was represented by Christian Girani.
The technical committee was represented by Charlotte Abadie (chair of the technical committee).
facts: After crossing the finishing line in race 3, ITA 213024 has been called for inspection by the technical committee.
The technical committee found a loop formed using a splice at the free end of the traveller on ITA 213024.
The control line on the two ends of the cleat of the traveller system had different thickness.
conclusions: By having a splice at the free end of traveler line, ITA 213024 broke class rule 3.(h). i.
By having a line of the traveller system not uniform in thickness, ITA 213024 broke class rule 3(a). i.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons a starting penalty of 20% was decided (Band 2). There were no circumstances to justify decreasing the penalty. There were no circumstances to justify increasing the penalty. The penalty given to ITA 213024 is a 20% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in rule 44.3(c) and applied to race number 03.
